tagline: advancing the world's infrastructure for better quality of life
hero_kpi_rationale: ARR is the primary driver of Bentley Systems' growth, reflecting recurring value and customer loyalty in the infrastructure engineering space.

kpis.name: Annual Recurring Revenue
kpis.explanation: Projected annual revenue from recurring license and service contracts.
kpis.description: ARR represents annual recurring revenue from subscriptions and services, a key indicator of predictability and growth.
kpis.signal: Strong ARR growth, a key indicator of the health and expansion of the subscription model.

kpis.name: Total revenues
kpis.explanation: Total amount of revenue generated by the company.
kpis.description: Total revenue includes income from subscriptions, perpetual licenses, and services.
kpis.signal: Double-digit revenue growth, driven by subscriptions.

kpis.name: Subscription revenues
kpis.description: Subscription revenues represent the majority of total revenue and are the primary growth engine.
kpis.signal: Strong subscription revenue growth, confirming the transition to a SaaS model.

kpis.name: Net recurring revenue retention rate
kpis.explanation: Measures the growth of recurring revenue from existing customers.
kpis.description: This rate measures the evolution of recurring revenue from existing customers, including expansions and contractions.
kpis.signal: Retention rate above 100%, indicating revenue expansion from existing customers.

kpis.name: Operating income
kpis.explanation: Profit generated from the company's core operations.
kpis.description: Operating income reflects profitability from core activities before interest and taxes.
kpis.signal: Significant growth in operating income, demonstrating effective cost management.

kpis.name: Cash flow from operations
kpis.explanation: Cash generated from core operating activities.
kpis.description: Cash flow from operations indicates the company's ability to generate cash from its primary business activities.
kpis.signal: Strong increase in cash flow from operations, a sign of solid financial health.

kpis.name: Public Works/Utilities ARR %
kpis.explanation: Percentage of ARR derived from public works and utilities sectors.
kpis.description: Indicates the company's reliance on public infrastructure and utility sectors.
kpis.signal: High concentration in public infrastructure and utilities, a stable and essential market.

kpis.name: Resources ARR %
kpis.explanation: Percentage of ARR derived from natural resources sectors (oil, gas, mining).
kpis.description: Represents the contribution of the resources sector to the company's total ARR.
kpis.signal: Significant diversification into the resources sector, although less dominant than the public sector.

kpis.name: Constant currency ARR growth rate
kpis.explanation: ARR growth adjusted for foreign exchange rate fluctuations.
kpis.description: This KPI measures real ARR growth excluding the impact of currency movements.
kpis.signal: Strong organic ARR growth, independent of foreign exchange effects.

kpis.name: Constant currency total revenues growth
kpis.explanation: Total revenue growth adjusted for foreign exchange rate fluctuations.
kpis.description: Indicates revenue growth excluding the impact of currency exchange rate variations.
kpis.signal: Organic revenue growth, demonstrating the resilience of the business model.

kpis.name: Constant currency subscriptions revenues growth
kpis.explanation: Subscription revenue growth adjusted for foreign exchange rate fluctuations.
kpis.description: Measures subscription revenue growth without the effect of currency changes.
kpis.signal: Sustained organic growth in subscription revenues, a cornerstone of the company's strategy.

risks.title: Currency fluctuations
risks.score_rationale: The report states that 33% of revenues and 45% of operating expenses are in currencies other than the US dollar, exposing the company to currency fluctuation risks. The company does not hedge these risks.

risks.title: Increased competition
risks.score_rationale: The market for infrastructure design and management software is highly competitive, which could impact the company's market share and revenues.

risks.title: Technology dependence
risks.score_rationale: The company is highly dependent on technology, making it vulnerable to risks related to system security and stability.

risks.title: Geopolitical risks
risks.score_rationale: The company operates in numerous countries, exposing it to geopolitical risks such as changes in political regimes, sanctions, and trade tariffs.
